sections.overview: The Brown Widow is a warm-region member of the widow genus Latrodectus.
sections.identification: Its colour varies from tan to dark brown; the underside has an orange hourglass.
sections.habitat: It often webs in sheltered spots around buildings and garden furniture.
sections.diet: Its irregular web catches small arthropods.
sections.behavior: When disturbed, it may retreat or drop from its web.
sections.reproduction: The egg sac is covered in distinctive pointed silk projections.
sections.ecology: It shares its genus with the Redback (L. hasselti), Katipō (L. katipo) and Northern Black Widow (L. variolus).
sections.conservation: The sources describe its biology, not a global conservation assessment.
